critical_code_review_comments: Round-naming fix `_name_for_round` in routes/leagues.py uses distance-from-final, correctly producing QF/SF/Champ for total_rounds=3 and Round of 16/QF/SF/Champ for total_rounds=4. Validated by 4 unit cases (2/4/8/16 team) — all pass.
Matchup synthesis loop correctly pads missing TBD slots so SF always has 2 matchups in an 8-team bracket; synthetic entries carry is_synthetic=true + iter-107 'Winner of X vs Y' label.
Champion block decided=true ONLY when final matchup status==completed — banner gating in PlayoffBracket.tsx (`champion.decided === true`) matches this contract. Verified hidden state in current run.

Minor observation: GET /playoff-bracket returns champion.distributed=true even when champion.decided=false (because payout was saved separately in a prior test). Not a bug per se (banner only renders when decided), but worth flagging — could be confusing for any client consuming `distributed` independently.

Mark-winner button gating in MatchupCard (canMark) correctly suppresses for synthetic matchups, completed matchups, and missing team_ids. Non-commissioner gating relies on isCommish derived from useAuth + activeLeague.commissioner_id/co_commissioners/commissioner_ids/created_by — pattern is sound but should ideally also gate at backend (already confirmed 401/403 there).
